product_summary: Cosmo First Limited (formerly Cosmo Films) is an Indian specialty-films manufacturer, not a trader. Per its own corporate site (cosmofirst.com) and the Cosmo Films product catalogue (cosmofilms.com), the real product lines are: (1) BOPP films — flexible packaging, lamination, industrial, thermal lamination, metallized, coated; (2) CPP and CSP films; (3) BOPET / polyester films, metallized PET, high-shrinkage films; (4) PET-G films; (5) lidding films (PET and CPP); (6) BOPP labels — in-mould labels, wrap-around labels, pressure-sensitive label face stock; (7) synthetic paper (non-tearable, oil/water-resistant, printable); (8) green graphic films (PVC-free BOPP); (9) capacitor-grade metallized PP films ('Cosmo Super'); (10) rigid packaging via Cosmo Plastech — rigid sheets, thermoformed and injection-moulded thin-wall containers; (11) consumer surface-protection films — Cosmo Sunshield window films, Cosmo PPF paint protection film, Cosmo Guard; (12) Cosmo Speciality Chemicals — 56+ specialty chemical products, masterbatch, coating/adhesive chemicals. Stated installed capacities (own site): BOPP 277,200 TPA, thermal films 26,000 TPA, coated films 45,000 TPA, metallized films 57,000 TPA, CPP 30,000 TPA, CSP 7,200 TPA, BOPET 36,000 TPA, PET-G 12,000 TPA, rigid packaging 10,000 TPA, capacitor films 1,000 TPA; 4 plants in India (Waluj and Shendra, Aurangabad; Karjan, Vadodara).
role_hint: manufacturer (own production lines and stated installed capacities; no trader signs found on the site — no 'we are a trading house / sourcing agent' language, no third-party brand resale)
comment: HS mapping: PARTIAL match. Declared 3920.20 (PP film) and 3920.62 (PET film) are correct and are the company's core business — these are the two codes that genuinely describe the bulk of the range. 3919.90 is correct only for the self-adhesive label-stock and adhesive-coated film lines, i.e. a minority of output, not a primary code. 3920.10 (ethylene polymers) is NOT corroborated by any product line on the catalogue — the company works in PP, PET, PET-G and CPP, not polyethylene film; this code looks like a generic 'plastic film' filler and should be dropped or replaced. Missing from the declaration: 3920.63 (PET-G / high-shrinkage films), 3921.90 (thermal lamination, coated and metallized non-self-adhesive films — a very large share of capacity: 26,000 TPA thermal + 45,000 TPA coated + 57,000 TPA metallized), synthetic paper (4823.90/4811.90), rigid packaging containers and sheets (3923.30/3923.90, Cosmo Plastech), capacitor-grade metallized PP film, and the entire Cosmo Speciality Chemicals line (Chapter 32/34/38/39 chemicals) plus masterbatch. Industry classification is WRONG: 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) does not fit — this is a plastics/flexible-packaging film converter (plastics processing, Chapter 39), with a small specialty-chemicals division. Correct classification: plastics & packaging films / polymer processing. Note also the name discrepancy: input says 'Comso Films Limited' (typo) and legal_claimed 'COSMO FIRST LIMITED' — the operating brand is 'Cosmo Films', a division of Cosmo First Limited; the site confirms both names. Per project rule 3, the HS mismatch is NOT grounds for rejection: company is retained, codes corrected to the factual range above, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. IMPORTANT per rule 5: all product data above comes from the company's own website and catalogue only. No customs line, B/L, GST turnover or public-procurement record was checked in this task (out of scope for the HS role), therefore the actual export/internal shipment status of every product line is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — the site's capacity figures and '100+ countries we serve since 1981' are marketing claims, not verified shipment records.
